name: Nathan Hale
source:
Nathan is a miserable functioning alcoholic who’s found himself at a crossroad of working to pay the bills or pursuing the things he actually wants to do with his life. It isn’t until he meets [url=/c148291]MC[/url] that he stumbles upon his own answer.
